events.quote_anchor: THE moment Serena’s illusion shattered, so did the ice surrounding Eli.

events.did: watched the frozen tomb around him crumble as the real world rushed back and the sisters’ well-lit house was replaced by Madman’s Mansion

events.did: staggered and gasped, sank to one knee and let out a guttural sound, blood dripping from his nose, eyes and ears
events.quote_anchor: Eli staggered and gasped, lungs hitching as they finally found air. Sank to one knee, and let out a guttural sound, blood dripping from his nose, his eyes, his ears.

events.did: retched blood onto the floor while Noah’s voice played in the room and in his ear

events.did: fired a single dart into the base of Noah’s throat when Noah moved to block his way
events.quote_anchor: But Eli wasn’t in the mood. He fired a single dart into the base of Noah’s throat.

events.did: reached up to rip the dart out of his throat but was too late
events.quote_anchor: he said, voice already slurring as he reached up to rip it out. Too late.

events.did: stepped around Noah’s body, said into his comm that Noah was staying with Serena, and took off up the stairs
events.quote_anchor: “Noah’s staying with Serena,” he said into his comm as he took off up the stairs.
